_meta.statistical_terminology_note: Terminology corrected from V0.1. 'P30/P75' replaced by 'CONSENSUS_LOW/CONSENSUS_HIGH'. 'fair_price' replaced by 'WEIGHTED_MARKET_ANCHOR'. These are weighted aggregates of external published ranges — NOT FIXEO-calculated statistical percentiles over raw transactions.
_meta.dual_fairness_principle: A FIXEO price is acceptable only if it simultaneously protects the client from arbitrary overpricing AND the artisan from economically unsustainable underpricing. Neither side alone determines the reference.

fuel_cost_scenarios.note: Casablanca urban round-trip. Scenario estimates only — no artisan cost survey conducted.

artisan_economic_floor_casablanca.note: Below 100 MAD artisan net after commission + fuel = intervention likely uneconomic for professional artisan in Casablanca. Basis: qualitative reasoning from artisan monthly income targets and job-per-day assumptions. Not validated by artisan cost survey.

_meta.disclaimer: All prices in this calibration are RESEARCH ARTIFACTS. They are NOT FIXEO prices. They require formal human product review and approval before any production use.

visual identification of the fuite

accessible plumbing — no wall/floor/ceiling opening required

excluded: leak inside wall, floor, or ceiling (→ fuite_encastree)

pipe access requires tile or wall removal
more than one leak point discovered

commission_sensitivity.commission_risk_at_20pct: ACCEPTABLE — 106 MAD net. Monitor if commission rises further.

services.label_fr: Débouchage évier ou lavabo — méthode manuelle

included: artisan travel within normal service zone
one blocked fixture: évier (kitchen) OR lavabo (bathroom basin)
manual method: déboucheur à pression, ventouse, furet manuel ≤5m
siphon inspection, cleaning, basic re-seating (no replacement)
one intervention attempt at the fixture
excluded: multiple simultaneous fixtures (each additional = separate quote)
motorized furet / hydro-jetting (→ professional method, separate quote)
siphon replacement (new part >50 MAD = client-quoted separately)
colonne or shared pipe access (→ debouchage_colonne)
chemical treatment beyond standard plumber's agent

pre_arrival_classification_questions: Which fixture: kitchen sink, bathroom basin, or bath/shower?
Do multiple fixtures seem blocked? (→ escalate: shared pipe or colonne)
Has it been recurring over weeks? (→ may indicate structural issue or colonne)
Is water backing up into another fixture when this one drains? (→ escalate to colonne)

simple_manual: single fixture, recent blockage, slow drain — no backing-up
may_need_professional: partial success on prior manual attempt

complexity_escape_conditions: simple manual method fails on-site
blockage located deeper than furet reach
multiple fixtures found affected on arrival
siphon cracked or corroded (requires replacement >50 MAD)
access obstructed (built-in furniture, under-sink unit with no clearance)
